  FROM treasury_post AS p

  GROUP BY p.cash_day, p.facility_code, r.net_allowed
)

         i.penalty_points + MAX(0, -(i.bikes + p.bike_delta)) * c.rental_points
                          + MAX(0, i.bikes + p.bike_delta - c.dock_count) * c.return_points

         SUM(s.frequency * CASE

           WHEN INSTR(s.detects, b.code) > 0 THEN a.minutes + b.minutes
           ELSE a.minutes + b.minutes + c.minutes
         END) AS weighted_minutes,
         SUM(s.frequency) AS detectable_count
  FROM inspections AS a

  CROSS JOIN inspections AS c
  CROSS JOIN scenarios AS s

WITH facility_day AS (
  SELECT p.cash_day,
         CASE WHEN r.net_allowed = 1 THEN MAX(SUM(p.signed_cents), 0) ELSE SUM(MAX(p.signed_cents, 0)) END AS receipts,
         CASE WHEN r.net_allowed = 1 THEN MAX(-SUM(p.signed_cents), 0) ELSE SUM(MAX(-p.signed_cents, 0)) END AS repayments
  FROM treasury_post AS p
  JOIN facility_rule AS r ON r.facility_code = p.facility_code
  GROUP BY p.cash_day, p.facility_code, r.net_allowed
)
SELECT cash_day, SUM(receipts) AS receipts_cents, SUM(repayments) AS repayments_cents
FROM facility_day
GROUP BY cash_day
ORDER BY cash_day ASC

WITH RECURSIVE inventory(opening_bikes, pulse_no, bikes, penalty_points) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT opening_bikes, 0, opening_bikes, 0
  FROM stock_option
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.opening_bikes, p.pulse_no,
         MIN(c.dock_count, MAX(0, i.bikes + p.bike_delta)),
         i.penalty_points + MAX(0, -(i.bikes + p.bike_delta)) * c.rental_points
                          + MAX(0, i.bikes + p.bike_delta - c.dock_count) * c.return_points
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN demand_pulse AS p ON p.pulse_no = i.pulse_no + 1
  CROSS JOIN service_card AS c
)
SELECT i.opening_bikes, i.bikes AS closing_bikes, i.penalty_points, c.source_id
FROM inventory AS i
CROSS JOIN service_card AS c
WHERE i.pulse_no = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand_pulse)
ORDER BY i.penalty_points, i.opening_bikes
LIMIT 1
